findings.message: All error mechanisms that flip observables also trigger detectors.

findings.name: sensitivity

findings.name: observable_coverage

findings.name: probability_bounds
findings.message: All error mechanism probabilities are finite and strictly positive.

findings.name: duplicates
findings.message: Found 67 duplicate mechanism signature(s) across 67 distinct location(s). Distinct fault paths can legitimately share a (detector, observable) signature on multi-round circuit-level DEMs (signature collision); if this DEM was assembled by concatenating sub-circuit DEMs, the same fault path may instead be double-counted. The decoder-facing probability for a shared signature is the XOR-folded value p_eff = p1*(1-p2) + p2*(1-p1) (iterated for 3+), shown per group in the counter-example. 67 of 67 group(s) are mixed (mechanisms with different decomposition structures share only the merged signature — distinct fault paths, not true duplicates).

findings.name: correctability

findings.name: null_mechanism
findings.message: No mechanism has empty detector and observable support.
